chunks: From him, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Sayf ibn ʿUmayrah, from Abū Bakr al-Ḥaḍramī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
There is no rinsing of the mouth upon you, nor sniffing water into the nose, because they are part of the interior.

key_terms.الْجَوْفِ: the internal cavity or interior of the body
key_terms.لَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ: it is not obligatory upon you

ai.seo_question: Is rinsing the mouth and nose obligatory for the junub in ghusl?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that rinsing the mouth and sniffing water into the nose are not required in this context. The reason given is that both are considered connected to the interior of the body.
